verdict.rationale: The ranking-and-relevance guide has sections titled "Text Match Score & Type", "Tie-Breaking-based Ranking" and "Default Ranking Order". This suggests the documentation explains how scores are computed and ordered, but the evidence consists only of section headings. Missing for 10: evidence that per-result ranking scores are returned in search responses, any explain/debug API showing why a result ranked where it did, per-signal score breakdowns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
